summary: S002 describes the 24-Nov action amid the continuing health-sector strike/union demands following the 12-Nov 48-hour action. Record as a later discrete campaign action; sources do not establish uninterrupted daily street protest or a December link.

S003 explicitly says health-worker protest continued and names unions/demands also identified around 24 November. This supports a same-sector follow-up within November, not a continuous daily assembly or continuity into December.
